question.text:
Assume:

  • $\texttt{char}$ takes $1$ byte
     
  • $\texttt{int}$ takes $4$ bytes
     
  • $\texttt{int}$ must be stored at an address divisible by $4$
     
  • Structure size is rounded to a multiple of the largest alignment requirement
     

What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

struct Test {
    char c;
    int x;
    char d;
};

int main() {
    printf("%zu", sizeof(struct Test));

    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

struct Item {
    int code;
    int price;
};

void f(struct Item x) {
    x.code = x.code + 1;
    x.price = x.price + 50;
}

void g(struct Item *p) {
    p->code = p->code + 2;
    p->price = p->price + 20;
}

int main() {
    struct Item i = {10, 100};

    f(i);
    g(&i);

    printf("%d %d", i.code, i.price);

    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{10 100}$
     
  2. $\texttt{11 150}$
     
  3. $\texttt{12 120}$
     
  4. $\texttt{13 170}$

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

struct Book {
    char name[4];
    int pages;
};

int main() {
    struct Book b1 = {"CAT", 50};
    struct Book b2;

    b2 = b1;

    b2.name[0] = 'B';
    b2.pages = b2.pages + 10;

    printf("%s %d %s %d", b1.name, b1.pages, b2.name, b2.pages);

    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{BAT 60 BAT 60}$
     
  2. $\texttt{CAT 50 BAT 60}$
     
  3. $\texttt{CAT 60 BAT 60}$
     
  4. Compilation error

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

struct Student {
    int roll;
    int marks;
};

int main() {
    struct Student s[3] = {
        {1, 50},
        {2, 60},
        {3, 70}
    };

    struct Student *p = s;

    (p + 1)->marks = (p + 1)->marks + 5;
    p++;
    p->roll = (p - 1)->roll + p->roll;

    printf("%d %d %d", s[0].roll, s[1].roll, s[1].marks);

    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{1 2 65}$
     
  2. $\texttt{1 3 65}$
     
  3. $\texttt{2 3 65}$
     
  4. $\texttt{1 3 60}$

What will happen when the following code is compiled?

#include <stdio.h>

struct Node {
    int data;
};

int main() {
    struct Node n = {25};
    struct Node *p = &n;

    printf("%d", *p.data);

    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{25}$
     
  2. Address of $\texttt{data}$
     
  3. Compilation error
     
  4. Undefined behavior
